text:
maria: starting a fresh thread to nail down launch criteria + spec for multi-region routing + tenant isolation. goal: get a minimal shippable set that sales can promise and engineering can build in Q3. quick bullets pls.
owen: top customer asks we keep hearing: (1) per-tenant regional residency, (2) ability to reserve throughput (not just capacity), (3) stronger SLOs with financial SLA.
david: infra constraints: cross-region cold starts hurt p99. we need a cache-warmup policy and a fast KV-migrate path. also global quota enforcement is non-trivial.
lenora: from support/CS: must have clear error semantics for failover (HTTP 409 vs 503) so customers can react. also they want a flag to opt into "best-effort" vs "guaranteed" routing.
sylvia: pricing/legal: if we promise residency + billing separation, finance needs per-region invoicing + audit logs. expect extra 2-3 weeks of billing work.
maria: proposed scope for a 6-week MVP (narrow):
  - routing-policy DSL (region_affinity, hard_affinity, fallback_policy) + API docs
  - tenant slice soft reservations (percent-based) + burst window
  - migration CLI: traffic-shift + canary + auto-rollback
  - console: per-tenant p95/p99 and token cost bar
  - basic runbook + SLO tests (synthetic repros)
owen: important: keep hard isolation (VPC) out of MVP. treat that as Phase 2 enterprise only.
david: runtime work: implement prefix-cache peer-sync and a background KV replication stream. also an eviction policy that respects tenant reservations.
lenora: operational acceptance criteria:
  - canary traffic shift (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) works without >10% increase in p99
  - rollback completes within 30s on errors
  - fallback engages and returns 503 with header X-Redwood-Fallback: shared_pool when triggered
sylvia: launch gating (legal/finance):
  - data residency checklist per region filled
  - per-tenant billing flag present and tested
  - audit logs retained in-region when required
maria: sample policy DSL (rough):
```
policy: tenant_reservation
rules:
  - match: tenant: "acme"
    region: eu-west-1
    reservation: 40%
    fallback: shared_pool
  - match: tenant: "beta"
    policy: best_effort
```
own: scaling assumptions: if we allow N tenants to reserve R% each, need enforcement + a global reserved cap. propose default global cap = 40% of cluster capacity per region.
david: perf estimate: with reservation + burst we can keep effective waste <20% if we do elastic reclaim and preemption. without reclaim, waste could be 35-60% depending on demand skew.
lenora: customer comms: we must declare behavior on shortfalls (queueing vs immediate fallback). recommend fallback by default and an opt-in queueing mode with timeouts.
sylvia: SLA tiers proposal: standard (shared, best-effort), premium (soft reservations, 99th p99 target), dedicated (hard isolation, contractual, extra pricing).
maria: minimal API endpoints for MVP:
  - POST /routing-policies -> create/validate
  - GET /tenants/{id}/routing -> current policy + metrics
  - POST /tenants/{id}/migrate -> start traffic shift
david: obs/metrics needs:
  - per-tenant request/latency/cost time series
  - routing decision trace id for each request
  - fallback counter by tenant/region
own: rollout plan + ops gates:
  - alpha: internal customers only (2 teams) for 2 weeks
  - beta: 2 paying customers for 4 weeks (SLA optional)
  - GA: gated on metrics and legal signoff
infra-bot: epic created: LR-2107 "tenant-slices-and-routing-mvp" (staging).
lenora: open risks:
  - billing complexity for mixed residency + consolidated billing
  - risk of noisy neighbor if reservations abused
  - test coverage for cross-region failover scenarios is expensive
sylvia: mitigations: billing: require tenants to opt-in to region billing; noisy neighbor: enforce per-tenant QPS caps + throttling; testing: add synthetic traffic generator to CI.
maria: owners & immediate next steps:
  - maria: product spec + docs draft (due in 5d)
  - owen: capacity model + global cap proposal (due 7d)
  - david: proto for KV replication + eviction policy (spike 2w)
  - lenora: runbook + error semantics spec (3d)
  - sylvia: billing gating checklist (7d)
maria: ok please add any must-have items before Friday standup. we'll lock the MVP scope then. :sparkles:
